turns.content: Snow begins to fall thick and fast as we climb the high pass. I stamp my feet. "It's barely autumn. Was this expected?"

Brennic: *pulls his scarf over the scar where his ear used to be* "Mountains don't read calendars."
Mira: "Halvard's Atlas warns that early snow is common above the treeline here, though I confess I skipped that paragraph because it seemed so unlikely."
Tobbe: *wraps the oxen's legs in sacking, humming* "Oxen need socks."
I help Tobbe with the sacking. "How long to the top of the pass?"

Brennic: "Three hours, clear weather. Six in this. Maybe never."
Tobbe: *stops wrapping to tap the wagon* "Not never. Never is bad luck."
Mira: *looking up, snowflakes on her silver hair, smiling* "It is beautiful, though, and I do not think I have ever seen flakes this large."
I hand Mira a thick wool cap. "Beautiful, maybe. Put this on before your ears freeze."

Mira: *tugs it down over her hair, spectacles fogging instantly* "Thank you. I cannot see, but I am warmer, which is a fair exchange."
Brennic: "Ears. Keep 'em. Learned that the hard way."
Tobbe: *laughs, a big rumble, and pats Brennic's shoulder* "Brennic makes jokes when scared. Tobbe knows."
